selection: workload == projects, only after original guards; workload value never enters helper
rowJoin: opaque captureOrdinal within one method invocation only; no request/trace/downstream joins
phaseCaveats: Acquisition includes gateway configuration lookup, IssueAsync and the unchanged ValueTask bounded/unbounded await branch
HttpRequestAndProof excludes the outer DTO construction; proof failure may include message.Dispose while unwinding
SendAndBuffer includes CreateClient, default ResponseContentRead buffering, remote transit and HttpClient internal failure cleanup
JsonBody stops immediately after original ReadFromJsonAsync, before result mapping
Whole includes original inner response/request disposal, final timeout check and public CTS disposal
Whole minus phases is unattributed preparation/mapping/check/cleanup; not exact disposal
Missing JSON phase does not reveal an owner decision or result

processPlan.slowCases: fresh helper process/window per slow case, exact eligible admission required
processPlan.cleanup: only fixed synthetic files after owned process exit, complete closed receipt and archive; preserve failures
